assumptions.choice: Aggregate hourly bars into daily bars inside the strategy by tracking date transitions
assumptions.reason: The execution environment provides a single 1h data feed self.data, requiring daily closes and SMA20 to be computed from completed hourly date groups.

assumptions.reason: Provides a standard mathematical definition of daily SMA crossover.
